families.description: Webview commands, acknowledgements, host push message literals, and snapshot field names.
families.reviewPolicy: Regenerate and review literal diffs with every IPC contract change.

families.description: Schegent configuration keys and contribution constraints.
families.reviewPolicy: Regenerate after adding or changing any schegent.* setting.

families.description: Queue snapshot and persisted feature request status literals.
families.reviewPolicy: Regenerate when queue status or feature request fields change.

families.description: Workflow run status, pause causes, retry causes, and state schema version.
families.reviewPolicy: Regenerate with every persisted workflow state shape change.

families.description: Structured audit event literals and audit schema version.
families.reviewPolicy: Regenerate with every audit taxonomy change; unknown events must remain warn-and-preserve.

families.description: Backend runner request and raw invocation result field names.
families.reviewPolicy: Regenerate with every runner request/result boundary change.

families.description: Unredacted raw transcript sink bytes under .schegent/sessions/raw-<runId>.log.
families.reviewPolicy: Do not generate UI-facing schemas for raw transcript bytes.
families.exclusionReason: Sink-only unredacted bytes are intentionally never surfaced to UI or generated cross-release schemas.
